title: cargo-faster.toml
description: cargo faster's configuration: cargo-faster.toml at the workspace root, or [workspace.metadata.cargo-faster]. See docs/cargo-faster.md#the-configuration-file.

hot.description: The workspace crates people edit most.

accept.description: Findings that are there by design.

target.description: Only findings about this target or unit (glob).

layer.description: Dependency rules between groups of crates.

crates.description: The workspace crates the rule is about (globs).

must_not_depend_on.description: Crates they must not depend on, directly or not (globs).

cold_check_secs.description: Seconds a cold `cargo check --workspace` may take.

edit_rebuild_secs.description: Seconds the build after an edit to a hot crate may take: one number, or crate = seconds.

critical_path_max_crates.description: Workspace crates the cold check's critical path may hold.

no_new_critical_crates.description: The workspace crates allowed on the cold check's critical path.

max_duplicate_versions.description: Crates that may be built in more than one version.

flag.description: Crates that must not be in the build (globs).

allow_duplicates.description: Crates allowed in more than one version (globs).

jobserver.description: Whether builds share a jobserver with other builds.

profile.description: The cargo profile builds are measured with.

features.description: Features builds are measured with: `name` or `crate/name`.
